$comment: Rates and terms for every home (WorldEnterpriseGroup/mtcottages#72). This file is the only place these facts live: the microsite 'Rates & terms' block, the cottage cards, the property pages and the Offer structured data all read it. Ops change a value here through a merge request. Status: 'confirmed' = the owner confirmed this value for this home (needs value and source; a confirmed monthly rate publishes an Offer); 'listed' = part of the home's published listing (value and source); 'guide' = monthly rate only, the published luxury-furnished guide for the home's bedroom count (src/data/site.ts), shown as a guide, never as this home's rate; 'confirm' = not confirmed, the page says 'Confirm on inquiry'. A 'confirm' entry names the open question in notes/owner-decisions.md ('ask') and may carry a short note with no numbers. Validated by scripts/lib/terms.mjs at build time and in scripts/tests/terms.test.mjs.
